Query: SELECT D.*, D.DRIVERID_0 AS Driver, D.DRIVER_0 AS Description, D.ACTIVE_0 AS Active, D.XSALEREP_0 AS Sales_Rep, F.FCY_0 AS Site, F.FCYNAM_0 AS Site_Description, A.XFLG_0 AS XFLG FROM sagex3.PILOT.XX10CDRIVER D LEFT JOIN sagex3.PILOT.FACILITY F ON D.FCY_0 = F.FCY_0 OUTER APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 M.XFLG_0 FROM sagex3.PILOT.X10CADMVP M WHERE UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(M.XSALADMIN_0))) = UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(D.DRIVERID_0))) ORDER BY M.XLINENO_0 ) A WHERE UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(D.XUSER_0))) = UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(?))) AND D.XPWD1_0 = ? AND D.ACTIVE_0 = 2

SELECT DISTINCT avp.XSALVP_0 AS VP_DRIVERID, avp.XSALVPDESC_0 AS VP_NAME, adm.FCY_0 AS SITE, vpUser.XUSER_0 AS USER_ID FROM sagex3.PILOT.XX10CDRIVER adm INNER JOIN sagex3.PILOT.X10CADMVP avp ON UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(avp.XSALADMIN_0))) = UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(adm.DRIVERID_0))) LEFT JOIN sagex3.PILOT.XX10CDRIVER vpUser ON UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(vpUser.DRIVERID_0))) = UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(avp.XSALVP_0))) WHERE UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(adm.XUSER_0))) = UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(?))) AND adm.XADMINRW_0 = 2 AND adm.X10CWEBAPP_0 = 2 AND avp.XFLG_0 = 1

SELECT DISTINCT vp.XDRIVERID_0 AS VP_DRIVERID, vp.XDRIVNAME_0 AS VP_NAME, adm.FCY_0 AS SITE, vpUser.XUSER_0 AS USER_ID FROM sagex3.PILOT.XX10CDRIVER adm INNER JOIN sagex3.PILOT.X10CADMVP avp ON UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(avp.XSALADMIN_0))) = UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(adm.DRIVERID_0))) INNER JOIN sagex3.PILOT.XSALVP vp ON UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(vp.XDRIVERID_0))) = UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(avp.XSALVP_0))) INNER JOIN sagex3.PILOT.XX10CDRIVER vpUser ON UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(vpUser.DRIVERID_0))) = UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(vp.XDRIVERID_0))) WHERE UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(adm.XUSER_0))) = UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(?))) AND adm.XADMINRW_0 = 3 AND adm.X10CWEBAPP_0 = 2 AND avp.XFLG_0 = 2
